lines.text: Nobody is coming to save you.
Not your friends. Not your family. Not luck.
Every morning, you wake up with two choices.
Stay comfortable, and stay the same.
Scroll a little longer. Sleep a little later. Wait for a better day.
Or get up, and become the man you promised yourself you would be.
Discipline is doing it when you don't feel like it.
When it's cold. When you're tired. When nobody is watching.
That's where the real work happens. In silence.
The world doesn't respect excuses. It respects results.
So stop waiting for the right moment. Stop asking for permission.
Every rep. Every page. Every time you say no to the easy way.
Each one is a brick nobody can ever take from you.
Nobody will clap for you at five in the morning. Do it anyway.
Your excuses will always sound reasonable. That is exactly why they are dangerous.
Pain is temporary. Regret lasts forever.
Lead yourself first. Then lead your life.
Now get up. And go to work.
Follow for your daily dose of discipline.

caption: A reminder for every man waiting for someone else to change his life: discipline, silence and work.

lines.text: Motivation will leave you on the hardest day.
It shows up when life is easy, and disappears when you need it most.
That's why winners don't wait to feel ready.
They decide once. Then they show up every single day.
Rain or sun. Good mood or bad mood.
Discipline doesn't care how you feel.
It only cares what you do next.
Not what you planned. Not what you posted. What you actually did today.
The man who trains on the days he hates it builds a body nobody can fake.
The man who writes when his head is empty builds a mind nobody can buy.
Motivation is a spark. Discipline is the fire you keep alive.
So stop chasing the feeling.
Feelings change every hour. Your standards should not.
Set the alarm. Lay out your clothes. Make the first move before your mind can argue.
Do it tired. Do it bored. Do it alone.
The results will come quietly, long after the work is done.
One day you will look back and thank the man who refused to quit.
Follow if you're done waiting for motivation.

caption: Discipline beats motivation every time: how to keep training, working and building on the days you feel nothing.
